outcome: Experiment Authoring highlighting is stable across artifacts and Outline has been replaced by direct Search
owner_impact: Configuration, Initialization, Controller and Metrics now preload and retain the same Ace Python syntax mode instead of racing Ace's dynamic mode loader when editors are hidden or switched. The misleading compiler-derived Outline control is removed from the authoring UI. In its place, a normal Search field and Search button send the entered query into Ace's existing in-editor find UI, while line numbers, folding, diagnostics and completion remain intact.

next.text: The owner-approved Mac editor-fix scope in #513 is complete and the ticket is being closed. The live Lab is the place to verify the repaired highlighting and Search behavior; no successor ticket is implied by this scope.

technical_evidence: Ace Python mode is loaded explicitly from the same pinned Ace 1.44.0 CDN bundle before Python-like editor sessions are created, removing the prior per-editor dynamic mode-load race.
The active-tab and authoritative-source replacement paths reassert the expected Ace mode and force a full renderer refresh without replacing the source-of-truth textarea contract.
Experiment Authoring no longer renders data-vlab-authoring-outline or compiler-derived symbol navigation; it renders one Search text input plus Search action.
Search passes the entered query to editor.find, opens Ace's existing find UI and synchronizes the native Ace search field with that query.

Production browser smoke switches across all four core artifacts twice and requires ace/mode/python plus real highlighted tokens after every switch; it also verifies Search prefills and selects ARENA_SIZE and that no Outline remains.
